meta.title: Drift Pic — Share photos with a random stranger
meta.description: Put your photo in a bottle, cast it to sea. Receive a bottle from someone, somewhere.

home.tagline: Send a photo to a stranger.
home.sub:
Put your photo in a bottle and cast it to sea.
A photo from somewhere in the world will drift back to you.
